_comment: Basic subagent-spawn plumbing under plan-and-execute (request-pipeline/08-planning.md). The message is a clearly multi-step engineering task, so dispatch.go routes it to a PlanWorkflow. turn:1 is the PLANNING turn -> propose_plan with ONE checkpoint (no needs_approval). The single checkpoint turn (<turn:1>:cp:1) spawns a subagent via nested scripted_model_responses, folds its result back, then calls checkpoint_done. This is the exact fixture shape the caller_is_subagent NameError once broke (ANY spawn crashed ModelCall); it also proves a checkpoint turn can dispatch a real subagent child workflow (turn_id <turn:1>:cp:1:sub:1) and the plan still completes.

message.content: Delegate a dependency audit of the payments module to a subagent, then summarize what it found and note any follow-up work.

scripted_model_responses.content: Plan: delegate the audit, then summarize.

checkpoints.intent: Delegate the dependency audit to a subagent and capture its findings
checkpoints.done_when: the subagent has reported back and the findings plus any follow-up work are recorded

checkpoint_responses.content: Delegating the dependency audit to a subagent.

arguments.prompt: Audit the payments module's third-party dependencies for known CVEs and unpinned versions.

scripted_model_responses.content: Audit complete: one unpinned transitive dependency, no known CVEs.

checkpoint_responses.content: Subagent reported back: one unpinned transitive dependency to pin as follow-up. Audit checkpoint done.

arguments.note: follow-up: pin the unpinned transitive dependency
